notes.title: Smokin Potions on sale for the Wonders of Wizardry!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417977/2020bcd61dd0effa6a2c3b69371b910ead7895f1.png"][/img][/p][p]Smokin Potions is officially part of the [i]Wonders of Wizardry[/i] Steam Festival Sale![/p][p]Gather your friends and dive into chaotic wizard duels where every potion you mix could be your greatest weapon or your downfall. Up to 4 players battle in explosive local-multiplayer arenas, crafting potion bombs, triggering stage hazards, and even sabotaging rivals as a ghost after defeat. With multiple magical affinities to experiment with, customizable wizards, and fast-paced matches, Smokin Potions is built for both party nights and competitive rivalries.[/p][p]As part of the festival, you can grab Smokin Potions for 50% off, just $3.99, for a limited time. The sale ends September 25, so now is the perfect moment to jump in and see if you can outwit, outlast, and outblast your opponents.[/p][p]Check it out today on Steam and join the Wonders of Wizardry celebration.[/p]

notes.title: Smokin Potions is OUT NOW!
notes.content: [p]Smokin Potions has officially launched on Steam![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417977/e45f98ccf0b96592b9b927570b7d55dfbdef1f04.png"][/img][/p][p]What started as a small game jam prototype is now a full multiplayer experience. Grab some friends, plug in a few controllers, or use Steam Remote Play Together to join the chaos from anywhere.[/p][p]Smokin Potions is a fast-paced local multiplayer game where up to four players battle it out using explosive potion bombs. Choose your magical affinity, mix elements to create devastating effects, and compete in dynamic arenas filled with hazards, power-ups, and stage events.[/p][p]Even when you’re knocked out, the match isn’t over. As a ghost, you can sabotage your rivals and fight for a second chance at victory.[/p][previewyoutube="z61VGaWREvg;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Features:[/h3][list][*][p]Potion bomb-based arena combat with Earth, Fire, Ice, and Arcane elements[/p][/*][*][p]Mix elements together for unique potion explosion effects[/p][/*][*][p]Local multiplayer for up to four players with full controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Remote Play Together for online play[/p][/*][*][p]Sudden-death events and dynamic stage hazards[/p][/*][*][p]Ghost mechanics that let you sabotage after elimination[/p][/*][*][p]Cosmetic customization with unlockable robes, hats, and hairstyles[/p][/*][*][p]Gacha system for collecting randomized cosmetic rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Fast, replayable matches designed for casual and competitive play[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to everyone who supported the game during its development. Your feedback and encouragement helped shape what Smokin Potions has become.[/p][p]Sleeping Robot Games is just getting started![/p]

notes.title: Smokin Potions is in Steam NextFest!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, exciting news!

Smokin Potions is taking part in NextFest! The demo will be available until March 10th, 2025, so please take the time to download and try it out! We'd love to hear your thoughts. Follow the feedback link in game or find the feedback thread in our community hub to share your critiques and ideas with us.

Thank you!

notes.title: Smokin Potions Demo is Released!
notes.content:
The [b]demo[/b] for Smokin Potions is now playable on Steam!

 In the demo, experience a taste of the full game with limited access to two battle maps, customization unlocks, and a selection of scroll effects and power-ups. [u]Profile saves will carry over[/u] into the main game when it launches. So all of the cool hats you pull in gacha will be unlocked!

[b]Your feedback is important[/b] as this demo will be [b]actively updated![/b] Please use the links in-game to leave your thoughts about the game.

As always, our artist is looking for customization suggestions. Check out Smokin Potions Community Hub to leave your ideas! 

Hope you enjoy the game!



https://store.steampowered.com/app/3498340/Smokin_Potions_Demo/
